review: Repairs the actual round-108/109/113 standard item-prefix failures reported by Moss. This is an interface integration defect and current-run code reuse, not a newly invented physical shelter function. Installation sets a versioned diagnostic flag; prior strict-reference failures replay unchanged. Existing shelter mastery, four-round original learning requirement, physical laws, costs, material/geometry requirements, ongoing work, escrow and installed objects remain unchanged. Bare persistent identity and one item/object identity prefix resolve consistently; resource aliases and repeated prefixes remain invalid. Owned inventory resolution is independent of stale pickup coordinates. The shared resolver and failure journal retain structured accessible-only diagnostics, canonical identity, supplied reference, obstruction, operation ID, version, remaining work and actual paid effort. Successful inspection costs one performed round and 0.2 energy, no stock. Previously unrepresented dimensions stay unknown; lookup success does not certify load capacity. Project slots are not required and are never silently archived. A separate one-round diagnostic-contract study does not retrain or revoke existing shelter access. Actual newly observed represented geometry uses the existing understanding source only: prior own material-test evidence and identical geometry under renamed source batches suppress new-information rewards, and inspection never adds generic practice rewards. Six added isolated tests and all nine shelter regressions passed, including the exact captured branch, both accepted forms, stale coordinates, malformed/inaccessible/ground/unmodeled inputs, partial specimens, full project records, energy failure, deduplication and serialized active-build migration. Types/lint/build and selected browser check pass; three final screenshots were actually inspected and copied, showing lookup failure, resolved-but-unknown dimensions and supported geometry without a suitability certificate or finished shelter. Full unfiltered tests and identical 113-round prefix reconstruction are required before activation. No fixture route, stock or achievement enters formal agent state.
